boundsAndLimitations: Wording and reference-model measurement only; nothing establishes payload truth.
No admitted document changes: the registered relation document has 20 $defs and zero reference cycles.

Termination is measured on seven bounded cases plus the suite's existing cyclic-container-ref fixture; it is not a proof. The generalisation argument - chain grows by one distinct definition per $ref hop out of a finite $defs, and non-$ref recursion is bounded by the finite document - is reasoning, not measurement.

Because the guard is per-path rather than global, termination does not imply bounded WORK: a dense local reference graph can cost time exponential in the number of definitions while still terminating. Today's document is nowhere near that, and stating a complexity bound would be a new requirement rather than a clarification, so I do not propose one - but root should know it exists.
No suite was re-run and no source was edited.
The independent v11 review is still finalizing; I read its currently authored findings and advisories, not a final verdict.
